flags.message: No negative control, contamination not ruled out.

disclaimer: Results are preliminary. Novelty and contamination flags require expert confirmation before use in scientific publications. Model predictions are probabilistic and may contain errors. This report was generated by Synth Veda and does not constitute a taxonomic authority.

definitions.contamination_flagged: A decided sequence is contamination-flagged when it is in this report's contamination_warnings (results[].contamination_flagged, or contamination_score >= 0.5) or its decision.result_class is possible_contamination. sequences_contamination_flagged counts them; the taxa they named are listed in contamination_flagged_taxa, not in richness or top taxa. sequences_with_taxon + sequences_without_taxon + sequences_contamination_flagged = sequences_with_decision.
definitions.fraction_with_taxon: sequences_with_taxon / (sequences_with_decision - sequences_contamination_flagged); null when every decided sequence is contamination-flagged. Low-quality sequences are in the denominator (they never get a taxon) and listed under without_taxon_reasons.
definitions.reference_dbs: Distinct (decision.reference_db, decision.reference_db_version) pairs, counted per sequence; a decision names the reference DB whenever the lookup ran, assigned or not. This is DB usage, so contamination-flagged sequences are included.
definitions.richness_by_rank: For each taxon_rank, the number of distinct predicted_taxon names decided at that rank, over sequences that are not contamination-flagged (contaminants are not counted as observed taxa). Ranks are never mixed or summed into one richness: a genus-level call and a species of that genus are counted separately, each at its own rank. A taxon without a rank is 'unranked'. Listed finest rank first (species, genus, family, order, class, phylum, kingdom, superkingdom), other ranks after by name, 'unranked' last.
definitions.taxon: Per sequence: results[].decision.predicted_taxon at results[].decision.taxon_rank, the orchestrator's combined answer (after the plant genus cap). Sequences without a decision (written before the orchestrator) are not counted; a decision with a null taxon counts as without taxon. Contamination-flagged sequences (see contamination_flagged) are not observed taxa and are excluded from sequences_with/without_taxon, richness_by_rank and top_taxa.
definitions.top_taxa: (taxon, rank) groups of not contamination-flagged sequences by sequence count, ties by name, first 20; fraction_of_assigned = sequences / sequences_with_taxon. mean/min/max_percent_identity are over the group's sequences whose decision carries a percent_identity (arithmetic mean, 2 dp); taxon_groups counts every group before the cut (a row count, not a richness estimate).
definitions.without_taxon_reasons: For each decided, not contamination-flagged sequence with no taxon: 'low_quality' when decision.final_route is low_quality, otherwise the rule of the taxon step in decision_trace.combine (':' + its outcome when that is a status string, e.g. no_reference_assignment:below_threshold), or 'not_recorded' when the trace has no taxon step.

taxa.unavailable_reason: No sequence carries an orchestrator decision: this analysis predates the orchestrator, so taxon rank, percent identity and reference DB were never recorded. Re-run the analysis to get taxa. 3 of 7 sequences carry a legacy predicted_taxon without a rank; it is shown per sequence but not aggregated.
